name: Encrypted Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, an Encrypted Rune quietly calls promising new rogues to Anvilmar. Its message asks them to decipher its contents and seek out rogue trainer Solm Hargrin.

sections.title: A Coded Summons
sections.body: The Encrypted Rune is a discreet summons for those who show promise in stealth and cunning. Solm Hargrin, the rogue mentor in Anvilmar, sends the inscribed stone with ciphers for its bearer to decipher. The message tests whether a new rogue can read thieves' cant and introduces the shadowy craft needed to survive Dun Morogh's harsh wilderness.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Deciphering the rune leads new rogues to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar. He hopes to strengthen the valley's covert ranks amid rising local tensions. Along with bladecraft and stealth, Solm teaches vigilance and camaraderie. In a time of strained peace, rogues need to stick together.

faq.answer: The Encrypted Rune is a coded message for fledgling rogues in Coldridge Valley. It tells them to report to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar for training.
Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer in Anvilmar, sends the Encrypted Rune to quietly summon new recruits.

faq.q: Where should I take the rune?
aliases: who do i bring it to
faq.answer: Take the deciphered instructions to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley.
The cipher lets only an aspiring rogue who can read it heed the call, keeping rogue methods out of plain view.

angles.text: As a rogue, the rune is your first formal contact with Dun Morogh's rogues. It begins your training in stealth, quick blades, and survival.
As a dwarf, the rune calls you, another child of Ironforge in Coldridge Valley, to master the shadows and protect the clan's interests from beneath the surface.
